content: The guidelines provided by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) encompass recommendations tailored to various age groups. These age groups include children under the age of 10, adolescents aged 12 to 17, adults between the ages of 18 and 64, and older adults aged 65 and above. The guidelines specifically address the management of type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, gestational diabetes, and hyperglycemia.
